title: Integrate by parts
text: Use integration by parts with $$u=x^2$$ and $$dv=cos(x)dx$$. You will need to integrate by parts twice.

title: Put it together
text: The first round gives $$x^2 sin\left(x\right)$$ minus the integral of $$2x sin\left(x\right)$$. The second round gives that integral as $$-2x cos\left(x\right)+2sin\left(x\right)$$. So $$y=x^2 sin\left(x\right)+2x cos\left(x\right)-2sin\left(x\right)+C$$.
